title: Change approval escrow and risk-scored canary gates
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: We need a deterministic, auditable change-approval system for production model promotions that supports delegated sign-offs, time-bound escrow of approvals, and automatic canary gating driven by a risk score. Current workflows rely on ad-hoc Slack approvals and have produced long lead times + unclear audit trails for regulated customers.

Goal: Implement an approval escrow and risk-scored canary gate system that: 1) records signed approval bundles (escrow) tied to a rollout artifact, 2) enforces RBAC-based sign-off requirements per model sensitivity/entitlement policy, 3) computes a continuous rollout risk score combining latency/SLO, error rates, and quality regressions, 4) uses risk thresholds to advance/hold/auto-rollback canaries, and 5) surfaces verifiable audit logs and evidence bundles in Console.

Key features to deliver in this ticket: 
- Approval escrow: create immutable evidence bundle (signed metadata + artifacts pointer) stored in customer audit logs before promotion. Bundle includes approver identity, role, rationale, expiration TTL, linked PR and eval set. Hash and signature scheme to be reusable across Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
- RBAC sign-off matrix: policy engine that maps model sensitivity labels (low/medium/high/regulatory) to required roles and count of sign-offs (e.g., 1 PM + 1 Security for high). Supports delegated approvals with expiration and escalation.
- Risk-scored canary gates: define a risk scoring function (weighted sum of SLO breach probability, request-level error spike, embedding drift signal, and automated eval regressions). Create configurable thresholds for HOLD/PROCEED/ROLLBACK.
- Auto-rollback orchestration: tie risk thresholds to automatic rollback actions with optional cooldown and operator override. Rollback must capture rollback evidence and annotate audit trail.
- Console UX + APIs: surface pending approvals, escrow bundles, risk score timeline, and one-click revoke/override paths. Expose API endpoints to query approval state and to attach approvals to rollout artifacts.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Approval bundles are created and stored for a sample model rollout and include signed approver id, link to GitHub PR, and eval snapshot (link).
- Policy engine enforces required signers for at least three sensitivity profiles; tests cover delegated approvals and expiration.
- Risk scoring returns consistent numeric score and gates a canary progression in a staging environment.
- Auto-rollback triggers on a synthetic SLO regression (2x baseline latency over 5m) and generates an audit entry and rollback evidence.
- Console shows approval status, escrow bundle digest, and risk score timeline for the rollout.

Out of scope: deep ML drift detection model research (we will plug existing drift signals from ENG-41789), long-term evidence retention policy (separate compliance ticket).
